sources.title: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
sources.evidence_kind: current fixed and mobile coverage snapshot
sources.evidence_location: official HTML key findings and data-download sections
facts: Snapshot uses network information as of January 2026
Full fibre was reported available to 24.9 million UK residential premises
limitations: Figures are aggregates rather than parcel truth
Availability does not prove retail orderability

sources.title: Connected Nations - Planned Network Deployments 2026
sources.evidence_location: official HTML methodology and key-findings sections
facts: The report examines plans through January 2029
Plans are based on operator statements as of January 2026
limitations: Operator plans may not be realised
Planned coverage is not current parcel availability

sources.title: Connected Nations and infrastructure reports
facts: Index lists the Spring 2026 coverage update
limitations: An index is not the underlying dataset

sources.title: Mobile connectivity you can count on
facts: Ofcom launched the paper on 3 June 2026
It describes desired good and reliable mobile connectivity
limitations: A discussion paper is not a final decision
National objectives do not prove parcel service

sources.title: Switching off the UK’s 2G and 3G mobile networks: what you need to know
sources.evidence_location: official HTML timetable and customer-action sections
facts: UK 3G networks are described as switched off
2G networks are scheduled to close over coming years
limitations: Guidance does not prove local signal
